$Comment: The Burning Grave Candle again, for Grave Candles: the player hands in ten (Cost.Items, taken from the bag, storage or hotbar like any item price on this shop) and gets one Burning Grave Candle, the price of the Headless Horseman's hard ride. It turns the Grave Candles his Hoards pay back (a chance at one on the normal ride, one to four on the hard ride) into the next hard ride, so both rides are worth running. Requires is the Sweets offer's own lock: it opens once Old Jack counts the player a Regular (Friendly with Old Jack's Favor), and a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line. Keep the lock the same as Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle.json's. SortOrder 8 shares its place with the Life Essence offer, and the shelf breaks the tie by offer id, so this one follows it. No purchase limit and no rotation. Change Count to change how many candles it takes. Named by the item's own keys.
